rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on the porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to real property.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee reports four shingles blown off the back porch overhang during last weekend's wind event, with an estimated repair cost of $400. No water intrusion or additional damage. Policy has a $2,500 deductible, so this claim will likely not be covered, but it has been documented and routed for adjuster review.

case_facts.description: Wind damage - 4 shingles blown off overhang
